newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba in China pigment joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Ciba in China pigment joint venture.

text.p: Pharmaceutical group Ciba-Geigy AG said its pigments division had recently signed a letter of intent with Xiangtan Chemical Research Institute to form a joint venture in China's Hunan province.
A Ciba statement said the venture would produce so-called quinacridone pigments, which are high performance pigments used mainly in automotive paints and plastics.

Ciba Pigments, the world's biggest producer of quinacridone pigments, is a division of Ciba Speciality Chemicals, the grouping of five chemical businesses that is due to be spun off when Ciba merges with Swiss rival Sandoz AG to form pharmaceutical giant Novartis AG in the coming months.
"Ciba Specialty Chemicals will continue its strategic build-up of investments in China independent of the spin-off from Novartis," the statement said.
Ciba said it looked forward to swift completion of a joint venture agreement with Xiangtan Chemical.
"The joint venture will improve access to the Chinese market and contribute to the future strength of Ciba Pigments in the market," it added.
Prior to operation of the joint venture, Ciba Pigments would be responsible exclusively for the sale of quinacridone pigments now produced by Xiangtan Chemical, it said.
